Program coordinator salary (0.5 FTE): $30,000

Snacks and family reading nights: $5,000
Total: $48,000
input.narrative: Personnel. A half-time program coordinator ($30,000) will recruit and schedule tutors, coordinate with the three partner schools, and track attendance. Books and materials ($9,000) cover levelled readers for 90 students, reading logs, and consumables for the school year. Tutor training and background checks ($4,000) fund a two-day orientation and state background screening for 12 volunteers. Travel ($2,400) reimburses the coordinator's mileage between the three school sites at the standard rate.
